.tbl.compact td.actions:has(> .btn.icon-only.sm, > .dropdown > .btn.icon-only.sm, > .tooltip-wrap > .btn.icon-only.sm, > .dropdown > .tooltip-wrap > .btn.icon-only.sm){padding-top:0.3125rem;padding-bottom:0.3125rem}
.tbl th.expand,.tbl td.expand{width:1.5rem;padding-left:1rem;padding-right:0}
.tbl td.expand{padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0}
.tbl th.expand + .check,.tbl td.expand + .check{padding-left:0.5rem}
.tbl .expand-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);cursor:pointer}
.tbl .expand-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.tbl .expand-btn svg{transition:transform var(--motion-fast)}
.tbl .expand-btn[aria-expanded="true"] svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.tbl tr.row-detail > td{height:auto;padding:1rem 1rem 1.25rem 3.5rem;background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl.compact tr.row-detail > td{height:auto;padding:0.75rem 1rem 1rem 3.5rem}
.tbl.relaxed tr.row-detail > td{height:auto;padding:1.25rem 1rem 1.5rem 3.5rem}
.tbl .row-detail-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem}
.tbl .detail-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr;gap:0.25rem 1.5rem;margin:0}
.tbl .detail-meta dt{color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl .detail-meta dd{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tbl .row-detail .spinner-wrap{flex-direction:row;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.tbl.kv th{width:12.5rem;height:auto;padding:0.75rem 1rem;font-size:var(--font-size-13);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);font-weight:500;border-right:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);white-space:normal;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em}
.tbl.kv td{height:auto}
.tbl.kv tr:first-child > *{border-top:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.side-panel .tbl.kv th{width:7.5rem;border-right:0}
.tbl td.empty{display:table-cell;text-align:center;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);height:auto;padding:1.5rem 1rem;border:none;border-radius:0;background:transparent}
.tbl td.truncate{max-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td.truncate>.tooltip-wrap{display:flex;max-width:100%}
.tbl td.truncate .cell-text{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.grid :is(th,td):not(:last-child){border-right:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl.plain td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl .cell-sub{display:block;font-size:var(--font-size-12);line-height:max(1rem,16px);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.tbl td:has(> .cell-sub){padding-top:0.5rem;padding-bottom:0.5rem}
.tbl tr.disabled .cell-sub{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.tbl tfoot tr.total td{font-weight:600;--tbl-tint:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl:has(> tfoot tr.total) > tbody > tr:last-child > td{border-bottom-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col{--tbl-surface:var(--background-neutral-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl{width:max-content;min-width:100%}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl :is(th,td){white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.nowrap :is(th,td){white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.nowrap td.empty{white-space:normal}
.card .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky),.side-panel .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky),.popup .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky){--tbl-surface:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :where(:first-child:not(.empty),.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){position:sticky;left:0;z-index:1}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(.expand:first-child + *){left:2.5rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(.check:first-child + *){left:2.75rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(.expand:first-child + .check + *){left:5.25rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > td:is(:first-child:not(.empty),.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){background:linear-gradient(var(--tbl-tint,transparent),var(--tbl-tint,transparent)) var(--tbl-surface)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(:first-child:not(.check,.expand,.empty),.expand:first-child + :not(.check),.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky.sticky-col .tbl th:is(:first-child,.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){z-index:2}
.tbl-wrap.sticky.sticky-col .tbl th:is(:first-child:not(.check,.expand),.expand:first-child + :not(.check),.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky{scroll-padding-top:2.75rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky .tbl th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky > .action-bar{position:sticky;top:0;left:0;z-index:2;background:var(--tbl-surface,var(--background-neutral-primary))}

.tbl-wrap.sticky:has(> .action-bar:not([hidden])){scroll-padding-top:6.0625rem}
.select-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;padding:0.25rem 1rem;background:var(--surface-brand-subtle);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.select-notice:empty{display:none}
.tbl .link{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.tbl tr:where(:not(.disabled)) .link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.action-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;padding:0.625rem 0;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}

.tile[disabled] .tag::before{background:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}

.chart-state > .skeleton.rect{height:100%}

.page-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:start;gap:1rem;width:100%;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:1rem}

.page-head .title{font-size:var(--font-size-28);font-weight:700;margin:0;letter-spacing:-0.0236em;line-height:2.375rem;word-break:keep-all}
.page-head .sub{font-size:var(--font-size-14);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);margin:0.25rem 0 0;line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em;word-break:keep-all}
.page-head .actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex:none}
.page-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.page-head .actions{justify-self:start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;width:100%;line-height:1.6}
